title: Natural vs Man-Made Discrimination
content: Distinguishing natural structures from man-made objects requires multiple supporting cues.
Useful cues can include morphology, acoustic response, shadow characteristics and surrounding seabed context.
A single visual or acoustic feature should not automatically determine object identity.
Automated classification is a prediction and should be distinguished from expert-verified interpretation.
When evidence is ambiguous, the system should raise an uncertainty alert rather than force a classification.
